This site is the Fiscal Document Reporting site for CFO Partner Locations. Please use the upload widget below to submit your quarterly reporting documents. For our home page visit [Center For Healthy Communities - CSU Chico](https://chcchicostate.org/)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(DT)
sbs <- read_excel("sbs_tef.xlsx")
```

::: callout-important
**Before submitting make sure the name of your files contain both the quarter (eg. Q3) and the short code name for your entity. Search the table below to find your entity short code name.**
:::

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
datatable(sbs, class = 'cell-border stripe', rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(pageLength = 5))
```
